# raglab

> A medley of tools to make RAG-based applications.


## Pages in this subsection

- [raglab](raglab.html.md): &#96;raglab&#96; — the agentic-search / RAG orchestration layer on top of &#96;ir&#96;.
- [raglab.agent](raglab.agent.html.md): The Composable Search Agent — roles wired by a control loop (ir_09).
- [raglab.judging](raglab.judging.html.md): Graded rubric judging — every candidate gets a level, three axes and evidence (raglab#8).
- [raglab.llm](raglab.llm.html.md): LLM-backed roles — the Formulator and Evaluator (ir_09 §8 steps 1 &amp; 3).
- [raglab.recipes](raglab.recipes.html.md): Recipes: whole workflows composed from raglab’s roles, ready to call.
- [raglab.recipes.corpus_labeling](raglab.recipes.corpus_labeling.html.md): Label a corpus against a topic, facet by facet, with a graded judge (raglab#8, part B).
